title: sarcochilus hirtus
intro: Sarcochilus hirtus, commonly known as the Hairy Sarcochilus, is a species of orchid native to Australia and New Guinea. It is a type of epiphytic orchid that grows on trees and rocks, and its flowers are usually white or greenish in color. The health benefits of Sarcochilus hirtus include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, sore throats, and digestive issues. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids and alkaloids, which have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties.
